title: Schema: named compound perturber effects in game definitions
description: Game definitions need a way to declare named compound perturber effects — libraries of game-specific moves composed from foundation primitives. Currently rule.effect is a plain string. Need to support structured perturber JSON so games can define moves like U, U', R2 (Rubik's Cube) or en_passant_capture (Chess) as reusable named sequences of foundation primitives (cycle, remove, flip, etc.). Two parts: (1) extend the schema to accept structured perturber effects in rules, (2) engine support for invoking named effects by reference.
